headline: 'Focused on the Finals': WNBA players tune out anthem talk from Trump, others

headline: Fever fire GM Amber Cox; Stephanie White expected to remain coach, sources say
description: The Fever fired general manager Amber Cox on Friday, hours after the team announced that president Kelly Krauskopf stepped down. As of now, the expectation is that Stephanie White will remain Indiana's coach, sources told ESPN's Alexa Philippou.
